adjudication_summary: Worker-6 re-review reopened the handoff packet, packet/final artifacts, quality feedback, rework ticket, primary XML/PDF, OA package members, figure captions/images, landed supplementary HTML assets, and linked DRAMP rows. Worker-2 extracted source-supported TP1/TP2 antiviral and toxicity rows, worker-4 reconciled DRAMP TP1/TP2 records to primary-source evidence, and rwk-complete-test-0001 is closed with cautions for figure-only values, HTML-only supplementary assets, broad database categories, and unresolved precise mechanism details.

paper_xml.coverage: article metadata, peptide synthesis sequences, IC50 method/result, cell-type inhibition results, ADE/JEV results, toxicity statements, mechanism sections, figure captions

paper_pdf.coverage: PDF text cross-check for TP1/TP2 sequences, IC50 values, percent reductions, toxicity, and mechanism statements

oa_package.coverage: main.nxml/main.pdf and gr1-gr6 figure image members checked as local figure surfaces; no image-only numeric values were fabricated

supplementary_assets.coverage: Landed .bin files identify as HTML/index pages and packet has no structured supplementary spreadsheet/table; no owner-layer value remains hidden in a parsed local supplement table.

merged_database_rows.coverage: DRAMP TP1/TP2 activity, experiment, and literature rows reconciled against primary sequence/activity/mechanism evidence.

supplementary_assets.note: Supplementary landing .bin files are HTML/index pages; packet supplementary text/tables contain no structured activity/toxicity spreadsheet values.

semantic_quality_checks.evidence: 30 TP1/TP2 records have endpoint, raw value/unit or no-unit rationale, target species, assay context, and source locators; combined cell-line toxicity statements are split by target.
Six linked DRAMP rows are source_verified with primary sequence/activity/citation locators; broad DRAMP activity labels are constrained by primary assay scope.
No linked row remains source_conflict after primary review, and broader database category caveats are preserved as cautions rather than expanded into unsupported assays.
Nine landed supplementary .bin assets were file-typed as HTML/index pages; packet supplementary table count is zero.
Direct mechanism claims are limited to ELISA/co-IP binding, RNase digestion, and binding inhibition assays; precise membrane-disruption mechanism remains unresolved.
rwk-complete-test-0001 closed after worker-2/4/6 source-reviewed repair and before gate rerun.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DRAMP31533/DRAMP31534 identity, sequences, literature link, TMUV IC50 values, BHK-21 no-cytotoxicity context, and mechanism comments are reconciled against primary XML/PDF text. Broad database activity categories are retained only as database provenance, not promoted to unsupported MIC/hemolysis or broad antimicrobial claims.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: The paper lacks XML/PDF tables but contains source-text activity values: TP1/TP2 IC50 in BHK-21 cells, qRT-PCR/plaque percent reductions, JEV/ADE qualitative effects, and toxicity statements. Figure-only exact plotted values are not invented.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism evidence is bounded to direct virion-binding, RNase digestion, and viral-binding inhibition assays. TP1 RNA release is separated from TP2 binding-interference evidence and unresolved precise membrane mechanism caveats are preserved.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Figures 1-6 may contain plotted values beyond prose, but local XML/PDF text only tabulates IC50, selected percent reductions, and one RNase percentage; no graph-derived numeric values were invented.
Packet pdf_tables and supplementary_tables are empty; activity evidence is prose/figure-caption based.
Nine landed supplementary .bin assets identify as HTML/index documents and add no extractable spreadsheet/table values for worker-2/4/6 blockers.
DRAMP Activity lists Antimicrobial, Antiviral; primary paper supports antiviral TMUV activity plus qualitative JEV/ADE context, not MIC/hemolysis or broad antimicrobial testing.
The paper supports TP1 RNA release and TP1/TP2 binding interference but leaves the exact TP1 membrane-disruption mechanism unresolved.

adjudication_scope: Worker-6 final adjudication of worker-2 activity/toxicity repair and worker-4 DRAMP database record audit for this one paper.
